orchestration_max_output_tokens_note: Output cap of one of the agent's own action turns, which are never scored. It lives here, in the runtime configuration, rather than in primary.json: primary.json is embedded in every Task Packet and hashed into every certified-cache key, so changing it there would invalidate every cached measurement. The third paid run ended learnability units on a single action turn cut off at 8192 tokens.
note: Read access is limited to the Task Packet's declared read paths. Writes and subprocess working directories are limited to /quidra-benchmark/work/agents/<agent-id>/. Subprocesses always run with shell=False, a sanitized environment and an argv[0] drawn from this allowlist or from an allowed absolute prefix inside the workspace. These limits are enforced in code by scripts/sandbox_agent.py, not by prompt instructions.
